provenance.label: Hyperliquid mainnet perpetual candles from the public info API (candleSnapshot); closed bars only

test.role: held-out: scored once with the frozen selections

train.role: selection: parameter sweeps and the frozen selection rule read only this window

cli_parity.mode: ad-hoc refs on the proxy cache, network blocked; batched slots carry explicit paper mode

protocol.overall_rule: pass only if the proxy and venue conclusions both pass; fail if either is fail; otherwise inconclusive. The registry keeps edge_status no_edge in every outcome

proxy.funding: charge (Hyperliquid hourly funding from the frozen isolated cache); off is a labelled sensitivity only
proxy.verdict_rule: inconclusive when any held-out window (oos, 2023, 2024, 2025H1) has a missing dataset, an incomplete funded leg (candidate, comparator or M1 incumbent), a funding row fetched during scoring or a frame whose hash differs from the freeze; when no `is` combination is eligible; or when the candidate has fewer than 30 independent position clusters in oos. Otherwise pass only if the contract-aware M1 verdict is pass in oos and in at least 2 of 2023, 2024 and 2025H1, the candidate oos mean return is positive, and the candidate oos mean Sharpe beats adx_trend and breakout under the same contract; else fail

protocol.selection_rule: candidate only, direction both, the seed close and stop, scored on the selection window (proxy: M1 `is`; venue: manifest `train`): eligible = every dataset scored, no incomplete funded leg, no liquidated leg, venue candle and funding coverage complete, >= 10 positions; pick max mean Sharpe, then max mean drawdown-adjusted return, then earliest optimizer-grid order; no eligible combination = inconclusive

venue.verdict_rule: inconclusive when venue candle or funding coverage is incomplete, any funded leg is incomplete, the provenance is not venue data, no `train` combination is eligible, or the candidate has fewer than 30 independent position clusters in `test`. Otherwise pass only if the candidate mean return is positive at cost x1 and x2, the contract-aware M1 verdict on `test` at cost x1 is pass, and the candidate mean Sharpe beats adx_trend and breakout at cost x1; else fail

proxy.limitations: Binance US USDT candles stand in for Hyperliquid prices. Proxy legs use the flat M1 cost model (Hyperliquid taker fee plus the engine's default slippage); they model no lot rounding, no minimum order and no spread. The smallest simulated proxy order is compared with the pinned venue gate above.

verdict.reason: held-out evidence is incomplete: 2023 adx_trend: 6 incomplete funded legs; 2023 adx_trend: 6 incumbent datasets with incomplete funding; 2023 breakout: 6 incomplete funded legs; 2023 breakout: 6 incumbent datasets with incomplete funding; 2023 candidate: 6 incomplete funded legs; 2023 candidate: 6 incumbent datasets with incomplete funding

venue.limitations: The venue windows cover 2024-09-01 to 2026-09-01 only (the venue serves the most recent 5,000 candles); the M1 2023 and 2024 windows have no venue equivalent. Spread is a per-coin half spread from one frozen L2 snapshot plus flat slippage; queue position, partial fills, liquidation and funding-rate impact are not modelled.

verdict.availability: edge_status no_edge in every outcome: hidden from discovery, explicit paper mode runs it, live use still needs allow_no_edge: true (the repository's acknowledged-live exception); a research pass approves nothing and promotion is a separate reviewed action
